storage: Keep whole bulbs at room temperature in a dry, ventilated basket away from sunlight; peeled cloves keep about a week in the fridge in a closed box.
looksLike: A papery-skinned white bulb made of several curved cloves, with a strong pungent smell when cut or crushed.
howToPick: Hard, plump bulbs with tight dry skin and no green sprouts or soft spots. Avoid damp, mouldy or hollow bulbs.
shelfLife: A few weeks to a couple of months in a dry, airy place (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
